# Sintera Czech

> Sintera Czech s.r.o. is a Czech recruitment consultancy that specialises in direct search (direct and executive search) for manufacturing and engineering companies. It finds people who have a job, are not actively looking for a new one and usually do not respond to job ads. It fills skilled trade and production roles (CNC programmers, machine setters, welders, fitters, toolmakers, maintenance technicians), technician and engineering roles, and management and top management roles. It works mainly in the Czech Republic and also in other countries of the European Union, for example Germany and Poland.

Sintera approaches suitable specialists and managers directly, instead of waiting for responses to job ads. The client receives a shortlist of candidates with context (why they match the brief and what to check with them), not a large number of CVs. The first candidates matched to the brief usually come within 10 days of the moment the role profile is agreed. A named consultant is responsible for each search project, not an anonymous process. Sintera works with international clients in English.

Evidence: cooperation with more than 130 manufacturing and engineering companies (for example ALSTOM, Siemens Energy, Nestlé, LINET, ZF, JTEKT, SITEL, Vitesco, Aisan Industry and the Railway Research Institute, Výzkumný ústav železniční) and more than 100 documented references.

Contact: Sintera Czech s.r.o., Company ID 29130336, Uhelná 160/24, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic. Phone +420 499 599 861, e-mail info@sintera.cz.

## Who Sintera works for
- HR directors, HR teams and management of companies that cannot fill specialist or management roles through job ads, including international companies with a subsidiary in the Czech Republic.
- Fields: manufacturing and mechanical engineering, automotive, engineering and design, quality and testing, electrical engineering and automation, logistics and procurement, service and maintenance, projects and construction, IT and SAP (SAP consultants, ABAP and embedded developers), finance, HR, sales and management.
- Where: the whole Czech Republic and other countries of the European Union, for example Germany and Poland (such as a sales manager or site manager for Germany).
- Levels: skilled trade and production roles (CNC programmers and CNC machine operators, machine setters, milling operators, welders, fitters, toolmakers, electromechanics and maintenance technicians), technicians and engineers (quality, design, manufacturing engineering, PLC and robotics), management and top management. Sintera is NOT only an executive search firm for managers.

## Language
- Sintera communicates with clients in English. A brief can be sent in English.
- Open positions are published in Czech, because they are aimed at candidates in the Czech Republic.

## How to start (for companies)
Send a job description or a few sentences about the role to info@sintera.cz, or call +420 499 599 861. Sintera will get back to you and suggest how to approach the role.

## Industries
- [Direct search in manufacturing and mechanical engineering](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/manufacturing-and-mechanical-engineering/): We look for machine setters, CNC programmers, welders, manufacturing engineers, foremen and production managers. We approach them directly, because good people in production have a job and do not read job ads.
- [Direct search for automotive](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/automotive/): For automotive suppliers, we look for quality engineers, process and production specialists, maintenance staff, design engineers and managers. We have worked with automotive companies over the long term.
- [Direct search in quality and testing](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/quality-and-testing/): We look for quality engineers, supplier quality engineers (SQE), test technicians and test specialists, quality managers and laboratory managers.
- [Direct search in electrical engineering and automation](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/electrical-engineering-and-automation/): We look for electrical designers, electrical engineers, PLC specialists, robot programmers, electromechanics and engineers for power electronics.
- [Direct search in engineering, R&D and design](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/engineering-rd-and-design/): We look for design engineers, development engineers, manufacturing engineers, technical project managers and heads of development and testing centres.
- [Direct search for service and maintenance](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/service-and-maintenance/): We look for maintenance technicians, electrical maintenance specialists, production line maintenance specialists, field service technicians and service managers.
- [Executive search: management and leadership roles](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/management-and-executive-search/): We fill roles for production managers, operations and sales directors, quality, procurement and project managers, and international management roles.
- [Direct search in logistics and procurement](https://www.sintera.cz/en/industries/logistics-and-procurement/): We look for buyers and procurement managers, project buyers, category managers, logistics specialists, dispatchers and logistics process analysts.

## Case studies
- [Candidates who had seemed unreachable](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/candidates-who-had-seemed-unreachable/): Technical roles for a data centre and emergency response · Systems integrator · Prague. Within a very short time, a large number of strong candidates came forward.
- [Accuracy over volume: 99% of candidates go to interview](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/accuracy-over-volume-99-percent-to-interview/): Quality managers and quality engineers · Manufacturer of automotive safety systems · Czech Republic. 99% of the candidates presented go on to interview, and most positions are filled through Sintera.
- [Specific positions in a short time](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/specific-positions-in-a-short-time/): Management and specialist positions · Aerospace and defence · Czech Republic. The cooperation has lasted several years, and candidates arrive with a good understanding of the position and the company.
- [An international manager ahead of schedule](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/international-manager-ahead-of-schedule/): Country Manager India and strategic management roles · Medical device manufacturer · Central Bohemia. The position was filled ahead of the planned date.
- [Roles where a well-defined brief made the difference](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/roles-where-a-well-defined-brief-made-the-difference/): Mould maintenance specialist, design engineer · Automotive and automation · Czech Republic. The selection ended sooner than expected, and further positions were filled in a short time.
- [A position the market had not offered for a long time](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/a-position-the-market-had-not-offered/): Textile specialist · Manufacturer of viscose and technical fibres · Lovosice area. The position was filled in a very short time, and the cooperation extended to further roles.
- [A long-term partnership across fields](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/long-term-partnership-across-fields/): Management positions and specialists · Certification, testing and automotive · Prague and other regions. The references confirm long-term cooperation, accurate profiles and filled senior positions.
- [A search driven by a detailed brief](https://www.sintera.cz/en/case-studies/search-driven-by-a-detailed-brief/): Quality engineers and technical roles · Automotive · Central Bohemia. Better identification of candidates and a flexible response when the profile changes along the way.

## Frequently asked questions
### What does Sintera Czech do?
Sintera is a recruitment consultancy that specialises in direct search (direct and executive search). It approaches specialists and managers directly who have a job, are not looking for one and usually do not respond to job ads.

### In which fields does Sintera find people?
Manufacturing and mechanical engineering, automotive, engineering and design, quality and testing, electrical engineering and automation, logistics and procurement, service and maintenance, projects and construction, IT and SAP in manufacturing companies, finance, HR, sales and management. An overview of specific roles is at https://www.sintera.cz/en/roles/.

### Do you only fill management positions?
No. A large part of our work is skilled trade, production and technical roles: CNC programmers and CNC machine operators, machine setters, milling operators, welders, fitters, toolmakers, electromechanics and maintenance technicians. We also fill roles for quality engineers, design engineers, manufacturing engineers, PLC programmers and other specialists. We fill foremen, production manager and director roles too.

### Do you also find CNC programmers, machine setters and welders?
Yes. We regularly fill roles for CNC programmers, CNC milling operators, horizontal boring machine operators, setters of CNC lathes and vertical lathes, welders, machine fitters and toolmakers, across the whole Czech Republic. Current positions are published in Czech at https://www.sintera.cz/pozice/.

### In which regions do you work?
Across the whole Czech Republic and in other countries of the European Union, for example Germany and Poland. We look for sales managers or site managers for Germany, and for people who speak German or Polish for Czech companies.

### How quickly will you present the first candidates?
Usually within 10 days of the moment we agree on the role profile together. The candidates are matched to your brief.

### Do you also do executive and top management search?
Yes. We fill specialist, management and top management roles, including demanding and highly specialised ones.

### How are you different from a standard recruitment agency?
We do not wait for responses to job ads. We search for suitable candidates and approach them directly, including people outside the active job market. Instead of a large number of CVs, we present a shortlist with context on why it makes sense to talk to each candidate.

### How does the cooperation work?
In four steps: we map the market, approach specific people directly, assess them and add context, and present only the candidates it makes sense to talk to. A named consultant is responsible for each search.

### Do you have references and proven results?
Yes. Sintera works with more than 130 manufacturing and engineering companies and has more than 100 documented references. We will send an extended selection of references to your company e-mail address.

### Who is responsible for the search?
A named consultant who knows your brief and the market. You do not deal with an anonymous process.

### Can we work with you in English?
Yes. We work with international clients in English. You can send the brief in English, and we will communicate with you in English.

### How do we start working together?
Send a job description or a few sentences about the role to info@sintera.cz, or call +420 499 599 861. We will get back to you and suggest how to approach the role.
